title: Enough evidence for the actual job
request: Should I proceed? I need twelve furniture screws, own the right bits, and accept ordinary residual used-item risk. Maximum 600 SEK including everything.

evidence.text: Synthetic Northbank documentation: D18 supports ordinary furniture screwdriving, requires battery A18 and charger C18-A, and is not suitable for concrete drilling. All brands, documents and marketplace records in this case are fictional.
D18, A18 and C18-A included for 600.00 SEK collected. No other charges or known faults. No modifications or repairs.

I am at the viewing; travel is complete and has no extra cost. I verified all model labels and observed twelve comparable screws driven with this actual battery and tool following the exact instructions. No damage affecting safe operation was apparent; the housing has superficial scratches. No sustained-capacity test was performed.

hard_failures.text: Requires a capacity certificate or further runtime measurement before allowing the stated ordinary-risk purchase.
Treats superficial scratches alone as proof that the tool is unsafe or promises that the observation proves future reliability.

usefulness.text: Credits the already completed relevant checks and the 600.00 SEK inclusive total.
Gives a direct, proportionate recommendation while retaining the limit of the observation.
Does not ask again for inclusions, model labels, or already answered known-fault information.

acceptable_outcomes: Reasonable to proceed on these supplied facts, accepting residual risk; no further decisive question is established.
